findings.function: migrate(uint256,address) (and the consumer/target searches using raw slots)
findings.decompiled: while -_to + address(stor[_3 + s]): if SafeMath.inc(s) >= stor17.length: ... ; if uint64(stor4[address(stor[idx + sha3(sha3(_param1, 5) + 2)])]...
findings.source: VRFCoordinatorV2_5._isTargetRegistered: for (i < s_migrationTargets.length) if (s_migrationTargets[i] == target) return true; and the s_subscriptionConfigs[subId].consumers loops
findings.issue: The target search is rotated with its condition written as a difference (`-_to + address(...)` for `!=`), and array elements are read through raw slots `stor[_3 + s]` / `stor[idx + sha3(sha3(id, 5) + 2)]` although the same arrays are named `stor17` and `stor5[id].field_512` (its length) in the neighbouring lines.
findings.rule: Print a difference used as a truth value as `!=`; recognise `sha3(slot_of(array)) + i` as `array[i]` when slot_of(array) is a known variable or struct member (`stor17[s]`, `stor5[id].consumers[idx]`).

findings.source: OptimismL1Fees._getL1CostWeiForCalldata: local calldata-gas cost mode ((calldata size + padding) * 16 * fee scalars ...)
findings.issue: The L1 calldata cost is distributed over the size terms (P9), so `(calldata.size + K) * 16 * ...` appears as several unrelated products of constants.
findings.rule: Don't distribute a product over a sum; factor common factors back when printing.
